description:
Delivery (`sent` · `link_given` · `expired` · `failed`) and the owner’s outcome (`declined` · `other_time` + proposal · `available` = free but NOT booked · `confirmed` = booked). `confirmed: true` only when the owner booked it.
Follow the server instructions «HOW TO USE THE VERSUM CATALOG»: results are candidates, not proof; keep reading, quoting, requesting and ordering separate; nothing is sent to an owner, booked, ordered or paid without the user’s permission.
name: request_status
title: What became of a request to the owner: delivery and the owner’s outcome
